request: Create a reusable prompt for reviewing a backend code diff. The review must prioritize concrete defects, avoid inventing test results or repository context, separate defects from style preferences, and return structured findings with severity and confidence.
title: Backend code review prompt
constraints: Do not invent repository files, APIs, or runtime results
Separate confirmed defects from hypotheses and style preferences
success_criteria: Every finding is grounded in supplied code/context or labeled as inference
